title_suffix: finer 1e-24 outer-grid certification of PR1218's global mixed X54 fusion construction (same construction, no new circuit)
summary: The identical PR1218 construction (125 base and 208 extra-group calls, X54, source-holder fusions, PR1193 global T37 allocation), replayed completely with the retained assembler's outer objective grid refined from 10^-18 to 10^-24, as PR1019 did for the T37 construction. No local word, owner map, profile or endpoint changes; only the final rounding grid of the nominated kappa does. The 1e-18 floor of the new value equals PR1218's 0.001675809683500501. The inherited compiler, hosting, precision and analytic-transfer obligations remain conditional.

The finer-grid certification method is PR1019's. All inherited sources and licenses are retained in the package. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2.
